title: Compact-support exchange map
statement:
Let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
\end{array}
$$
be a compact-support base-change square [def-cbc-compact-support-square], with $f:X\to Y$ separated of finite type and $g:Y'\to Y$ arbitrary. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. All categories in this definition are bounded below derived categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Choose a compactification $c=(j,p)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$, and its base change $c'=(j',p')$, with $\bar g':\overline X'=\overline X\times_Y Y'\to\overline X$ as in [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Use extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], applied degreewise; its exactness [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact] ensures that this descends to the bounded below derived categories. Relative to these chosen compactifications write
$$
Rf_!^cK:=Rp_*j_!K,\qquad Rf'_!^{c'}L:=Rp'_*j'_!L.
$$
Here $Ru_*$ and $u^{-1}$ are the derived direct image and exact inverse image for constant $\Lambda$-module coefficients, as in [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients].

For $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ put $M=j_!K$. Let $\operatorname{Ex}_{*,p}(M)$ be the module-coefficient derived exchange of [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients], formed by the same mate construction as [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. Explicitly, with $\eta_{p'}$ the unit of $p'^{-1}\dashv Rp'_*$, $\varepsilon_p$ the counit of $p^{-1}\dashv Rp_*$, and $\theta:p'^{-1}g^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\bar g'^{-1}p^{-1}$ the square isomorphism, it is
$$
g^{-1}Rp_*M
\xrightarrow{\eta_{p',g^{-1}Rp_*M}}
Rp'_*p'^{-1}g^{-1}Rp_*M
\xrightarrow{Rp'_*\theta_{Rp_*M}}
Rp'_*\bar g'^{-1}p^{-1}Rp_*M
\xrightarrow{Rp'_*\bar g'^{-1}\varepsilon_{p,M}}
Rp'_*\bar g'^{-1}M.
$$
The compact-support exchange map computed with $c$ and $c'$ is the composite
$$
\operatorname{Ex}_!^{c}(K):
g^{-1}Rf_!^cK=g^{-1}Rp_*j_!K
\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_{*,p}(j_!K)}
Rp'_*\bar g'^{-1}j_!K
\xrightarrow{Rp'_*(\beta_K)}
Rp'_*j'_!g'^{-1}K=Rf'_!^{c'}g'^{-1}K,
$$
where
$$
\beta_K:\bar g'^{-1}j_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}j'_!g'^{-1}K
$$
is the canonical extension-by-zero identification of [cor-cbc-derived-extension-zero-base-change] for the upper cartesian square with horizontal maps $g'$ and $\bar g'$. The notation $\operatorname{Ex}_!(K)$ denotes this compactification formula when $Rf_!$ and $Rf'_!$ are computed using $c$ and $c'$, respectively.

noncomputable def rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap [Finite Λ]
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (c : Compactification f) :
    Rf_!(c)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]+ ⋙ D+((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]) ⟶
      D+((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]) ⋙ Rf_!(c.ofIsPullback sq)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]+
lean.note: Exact compactification-relative construction in the published upstream source, read with scompile.py --source. Its component at K is the proper derived exchange at j_!K followed by Rp′_* of the inverse open-immersion base-change comparison. Unlike the canonical rightDerivedLowerShriekPlusBaseChangeMap, it retains the specified c and its base change c.ofIsPullback sq. See derivedPlusFormalism_pfBaseChange, derivedPlusFormalism_shriek and CompactSupportFormalism.shriekBaseChange. No new module or statement correction.
